question.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

exchange.sent: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list, but they identify the key Signal Integrity / high-speed digital capabilities to cover for wireless communication contexts such as mobile network infrastructure and wireless device testing: high-speed digital & power verification, interface testing, channel / PCB validation, RefClk / PLL jitter, PDN testing, ADC/DAC frontend testing, PCB SI flow, and wireless-specific MIMO / beamforming / OTA-related validation needs [7][16][72].
### Signal integrity capabilities supported by the passages
| Capability area | What to cover | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| High-speed digital & power verification | Wireless network infrastructure sources place “Digital Design & Power” among the industry drivers, and high-speed digital / power designs are described as verification / debugging areas needing fast, reliable, accurate T&M tools such as VNA, probes, phase noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source [7][72]. | [7][72] |
| Interface test | Interface testing is linked to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| Transmission channel validation | Transmission-channel validation covers Tx package, PCBs, connectors, Rx package, channel / test board / switch matrices, and the high-speed electrical interface path including Tx, Rx, EQ, ADC + DSP, and DSP + DAC [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| RefClk and PLL jitter performance | RefClk and PLL jitter performance testing is tied to phase noise analyzers and signal generators [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| Power Distribution Network testing | Power Distribution Network testing is tied to oscilloscopes and network analyzers [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| ADC / DAC frontend performance | ADC / DAC frontend performance is tied to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| PCB / PCBA signal-integrity flow | The high-speed PCB / PCBA SI flow includes insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner, and transmission-line calculator [2]. | [2] |
| PCB material, stackup, and SI modeling/testing | PCB test-solution flow includes material measurement with impedance by TDR and DK/DF extraction; stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram; and SI modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [6]. | [6] |
| Wireless MIMO / beamforming-related validation | Mobile network infrastructure sources identify increasing MIMO degrees and beamforming as drivers, and list up to nx8 MIMO generation & analysis, 5G NR multi-channel analysis, integrated fading simulation, beamforming component accuracy verification, simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports, and 2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification [7][35][70]. | [7][35][70] |
| OTA / high-frequency validation context | Active antennas and Massive MIMO make measured systems more complex, higher frequencies make conducted testing impractical, and OTA testing becomes necessary under higher frequencies / Massive MIMO [70]. | [70] |
### 推論
【推論】For wireless communication applications, the best-supported SI capability set is not a single ranked item but a combined coverage of high-speed digital / power verification, channel and PCB SI, clock/jitter, PDN, ADC/DAC frontend, and MIMO / beamforming / OTA validation, because the wireless infrastructure passages identify Digital Design & Power, MIMO / Beamforming, and OTA as drivers, while the SI passages identify the concrete SI measurement blocks and PCB SI flow [1][2][6][7][70][72].

R&S CMP180

來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

Beamforming › MWC 2025 mobile network infrastructure 簡報
依 [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]]（MWC 2025 Barcelona；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- [[Beamforming]] 被定義為：increases antenna gain by bundling transmitted energy and directing it towards the user。
- [[MIMO]] 被定義為：many antennas at the transceiver to increase capacity。
- [[Massive MIMO]] 被定義為：very high number of antenna elements at the transceiver，並且是 beamforming and spatial multiplexing 的 combination。
- 來源說 increasing demand for higher MIMO degree，且有 mid-band spectrum 的 operators 對 Massive MIMO 更有信心，例子包括 China、US。
- 來源說 [[Beamforming]] 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- 測試方案包含 up to nx8 MIMO generation & analysis、5G NR multi-channel analysis、signal generation with integrated fading simulation、[[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- 來源另列 beamforming components & accuracy verification：fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument、verify beamformer ICs for phased array antennas、2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification。
- 對應產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution，18 GHz–90 GHz）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。

answer.text:
### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list, but they identify the key Signal Integrity / high-speed digital capabilities to cover for wireless communication contexts such as mobile network infrastructure and wireless device testing: high-speed digital & power verification, interface testing, channel / PCB validation, RefClk / PLL jitter, PDN testing, ADC/DAC frontend testing, PCB SI flow, and wireless-specific MIMO / beamforming / OTA-related validation needs [7][16][72].
### Signal integrity capabilities supported by the passages
| Capability area | What to cover | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| High-speed digital & power verification | Wireless network infrastructure sources place “Digital Design & Power” among the industry drivers, and high-speed digital / power designs are described as verification / debugging areas needing fast, reliable, accurate T&M tools such as VNA, probes, phase noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source [7][72]. | [7][72] |
| Interface test | Interface testing is linked to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| Transmission channel validation | Transmission-channel validation covers Tx package, PCBs, connectors, Rx package, channel / test board / switch matrices, and the high-speed electrical interface path including Tx, Rx, EQ, ADC + DSP, and DSP + DAC [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| RefClk and PLL jitter performance | RefClk and PLL jitter performance testing is tied to phase noise analyzers and signal generators [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| Power Distribution Network testing | Power Distribution Network testing is tied to oscilloscopes and network analyzers [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| ADC / DAC frontend performance | ADC / DAC frontend performance is tied to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| PCB / PCBA signal-integrity flow | The high-speed PCB / PCBA SI flow includes insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner, and transmission-line calculator [2]. | [2] |
| PCB material, stackup, and SI modeling/testing | PCB test-solution flow includes material measurement with impedance by TDR and DK/DF extraction; stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram; and SI modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [6]. | [6] |
| Wireless MIMO / beamforming-related validation | Mobile network infrastructure sources identify increasing MIMO degrees and beamforming as drivers, and list up to nx8 MIMO generation & analysis, 5G NR multi-channel analysis, integrated fading simulation, beamforming component accuracy verification, simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports, and 2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification [7][35][70]. | [7][35][70] |
| OTA / high-frequency validation context | Active antennas and Massive MIMO make measured systems more complex, higher frequencies make conducted testing impractical, and OTA testing becomes necessary under higher frequencies / Massive MIMO [70]. | [70] |
### 推論
【推論】For wireless communication applications, the best-supported SI capability set is not a single ranked item but a combined coverage of high-speed digital / power verification, channel and PCB SI, clock/jitter, PDN, ADC/DAC frontend, and MIMO / beamforming / OTA validation, because the wireless infrastructure passages identify Digital Design & Power, MIMO / Beamforming, and OTA as drivers, while the SI passages identify the concrete SI measurement blocks and PCB SI flow [1][2][6][7][70][72].

Beamforming › MWC 2025 mobile network infrastructure 簡報
依 [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]]（MWC 2025 Barcelona；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- [[Beamforming]] 被定義為：increases antenna gain by bundling transmitted energy and directing it towards the user。
- [[MIMO]] 被定義為：many antennas at the transceiver to increase capacity。
- [[Massive MIMO]] 被定義為：very high number of antenna elements at the transceiver，並且是 beamforming and spatial multiplexing 的 combination。
- 來源說 increasing demand for higher MIMO degree，且有 mid-band spectrum 的 operators 對 Massive MIMO 更有信心，例子包括 China、US。
- 來源說 [[Beamforming]] 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- 測試方案包含 up to nx8 MIMO generation & analysis、5G NR multi-channel analysis、signal generation with integrated fading simulation、[[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- 來源另列 beamforming components & accuracy verification：fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument、verify beamformer ICs for phased array antennas、2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification。
- 對應產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution，18 GHz–90 GHz）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

Beamforming › 使用限制
- 本頁尚不能作為 [[Beamforming]] 的技術教學頁；缺少標準版本、發布組織、公式、架構圖與完整測試程序來源。

Beamforming › MWC 2025 mobile network infrastructure 簡報
依 [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]]（MWC 2025 Barcelona；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- [[Beamforming]] 被定義為：increases antenna gain by bundling transmitted energy and directing it towards the user。
- [[MIMO]] 被定義為：many antennas at the transceiver to increase capacity。
- [[Massive MIMO]] 被定義為：very high number of antenna elements at the transceiver，並且是 beamforming and spatial multiplexing 的 combination。
- 來源說 increasing demand for higher MIMO degree，且有 mid-band spectrum 的 operators 對 Massive MIMO 更有信心，例子包括 China、US。
- 來源說 [[Beamforming]] 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- 測試方案包含 up to nx8 MIMO generation & analysis、5G NR multi-channel analysis、signal generation with integrated fading simulation、[[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- 來源另列 beamforming components & accuracy verification：fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument、verify beamformer ICs for phased array antennas、2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification。
- 對應產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution，18 GHz–90 GHz）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。

Beamforming › 與既有頁面的關係
- [[FWA CPE 市場與測試分類]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）在戶外高階 [[mmWave ODU]] 的 EVT 階段列出 mmWave [[Beamforming]]，但未提供 beamforming 定義、測試方法或標準章節。
- [[低軌衛星零組件與地面終端供應鏈]]（2026-09-15）把地面設備與用戶終端的核心列為 [[相控陣列天線]] 與 [[RF front-end]]；本頁可作為該主題的待讀技術資料入口。
- [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]] 將 [[Beamforming]] 與 [[Massive MIMO]]、[[OTA testing]]、[[Network Infrastructure T&M drivers]]、[[R&S NRPM]]、[[R&S ZNBT]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S VSE]] 連在一起，是 mobile network infrastructure sales / solution view。
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]] 與 [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]] 處理 NTN validation、channel / propagation / fading 測試，不等同於 beamforming antenna design。

Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices › 重點摘要
- [[Bluetest]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擴展既有合作，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 整合到 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software。
- 整合後，next-generation WLAN technology 的 developers 與 manufacturers 可使用 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 在 realistic conditions 下進行 MIMO stress testing。
- 來源以 [[Bluetest RTS65]] 為例，說明 [[Bluetest]] reverberation chambers 用於 wireless devices 的 over-the-air performance evaluation。
- 來源說明 reverberation chamber 與 anechoic test chamber 的差異：reverberation chamber 會在 chamber 內大量反射 RF signal，形成 Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment；此環境接近 real-world indoor and city conditions。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] 被描述為 complex wireless solutions 的 integrated test environment。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，具 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality、multiple radio technologies support 與 embedded IP test capabilities。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的 key components 被列為 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM modulation 與 [[MLO]]。
- 來源指出 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature；因此測試環境提供 multiple RF chains 很關鍵。
- Rohde & Schwarz 引言人物為 [[Christoph Pointner]]，職稱 Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers at Rohde & Schwarz。
- Bluetest 引言人物為 [[Kjell Olovsson]]，職稱 Bluetest CEO。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement，email 為 press@rohde-schwarz.com。
- Rohde & Schwarz 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。
- Bluetest 公司資訊：[[Bluetest AB]] based in Gothenburg, Sweden；來源稱其為 wireless equipment and small antenna OTA testing using Reverberation Test System 的 pioneer and market leader。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list, but they identify the key Signal Integrity / high-speed digital capabilities to cover for wireless communication contexts such as mobile network infrastructure and wireless device testing: high-speed digital & power verification, interface testing, channel / PCB validation, RefClk / PLL jitter, PDN testing, ADC/DAC frontend testing, PCB SI flow, and wireless-specific MIMO / beamforming / OTA-related validation needs [7][16][72].

| RefClk and PLL jitter performance | RefClk and PLL jitter performance testing is tied to phase noise analyzers and signal generators [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| Power Distribution Network testing | Power Distribution Network testing is tied to oscilloscopes and network analyzers [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| ADC / DAC frontend performance | ADC / DAC frontend performance is tied to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1][2]. | [1][2] |
| PCB / PCBA signal-integrity flow | The high-speed PCB / PCBA SI flow includes insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner, and transmission-line calculator [2]. | [2] |
| PCB material, stackup, and SI modeling/testing | PCB test-solution flow includes material measurement with impedance by TDR and DK/DF extraction; stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram; and SI modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [6]. | [6] |
| Wireless MIMO / beamforming-related validation | Mobile network infrastructure sources identify increasing MIMO degrees and beamforming as drivers, and list up to nx8 MIMO generation & analysis, 5G NR multi-channel analysis, integrated fading simulation, beamforming component accuracy verification, simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports, and 2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification [7][35][70]. | [7][35][70] |
| OTA / high-frequency validation context | Active antennas and Massive MIMO make measured systems more complex, higher frequencies make conducted testing impractical, and OTA testing becomes necessary under higher frequencies / Massive MIMO [70]. | [70] |
### 推論
【推論】For wireless communication applications, the best-supported SI capability set is not a single ranked item but a combined coverage of high-speed digital / power verification, channel and PCB SI, clock/jitter, PDN, ADC/DAC frontend, and MIMO / beamforming / OTA validation, because the wireless infrastructure passages identify Digital Design & Power, MIMO / Beamforming, and OTA as drivers, while the SI passages identify the concrete SI measurement blocks and PCB SI flow [1][2][6][7][70][72].

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

Beamforming › MWC 2025 mobile network infrastructure 簡報
依 [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]]（MWC 2025 Barcelona；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- [[Beamforming]] 被定義為：increases antenna gain by bundling transmitted energy and directing it towards the user。
- [[MIMO]] 被定義為：many antennas at the transceiver to increase capacity。
- [[Massive MIMO]] 被定義為：very high number of antenna elements at the transceiver，並且是 beamforming and spatial multiplexing 的 combination。
- 來源說 increasing demand for higher MIMO degree，且有 mid-band spectrum 的 operators 對 Massive MIMO 更有信心，例子包括 China、US。
- 來源說 [[Beamforming]] 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- 測試方案包含 up to nx8 MIMO generation & analysis、5G NR multi-channel analysis、signal generation with integrated fading simulation、[[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- 來源另列 beamforming components & accuracy verification：fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument、verify beamformer ICs for phased array antennas、2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification。
- 對應產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution，18 GHz–90 GHz）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。
